create_direct_optimizer: create a Direct trajectory optimizer instance with a MuJoCo model and configuration length
set_optimizer_data: set trajectory data including configuration, sensor measurements, and force measurements for each time step
configure_optimizer_noise: configure process and sensor noise covariance for the trajectory optimizer
set_optimizer_settings: set optimizer settings including iteration limits, tolerances, and sensor flags
run_trajectory_optimization: run the direct trajectory optimization and retrieve optimized configuration and velocity estimates
